content: To obtain the vector representation of words, we used a freely available word2vec model, trained by BIBREF8 , on approximately 100 billion words, which encodes the vector representation in $\mathbb {R}^{300}$ of over 3 million words from several different languages. Since we decided to focus on English words only, we filtered these vectors to about 800 thousand words, excluding all words with non-roman characters.
